Package org.geysermc.paletter.block.component

Record Class Tick

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.geysermc.paletter.block.component.Tick
Record Components:
intervalRange - A range of values, specified in ticks, to decide the next tick interval for a block. A range of values, specified in ticks, to decide the next tick interval for a block. After each block tick, a new value will be chosen from within the range to determine the next tick interval. If the values in the interval_range are the same, the block will always be ticked after that number of ticks. The first value must be lower or equal to the second value in the array. Value must have at least 2 items. Value must have at most 2 items. Add-on JSON interval_range. Required.
looping - If false, the block will only be ticked once after a delay equal to a number of ticks randomly chosen from the interval_range and no further ticking will occur. If false, the block will only be ticked once after a delay equal to a number of ticks randomly chosen from the interval_range and no further ticking will occur. If true, after the block ticks, a new random value will be chosen from the interval_range for when the block will tick again. Add-on JSON looping. Default: true.
All Implemented Interfaces:
BlockComponent
@ServerOnly public record Tick(@NonNull List<Float> intervalRange, boolean looping) extends Record implements BlockComponent
Causes the block to tick based on a regular interval equal to a number of ticks randomly chosen from the internal_range parameter. This ticking will send the onTick event to blocks with custom components subscribed for the event. Custom components listening to the onTick event that are added to a block that does not have the minecraft:tick component will cause a content error.

Add-on JSON: "minecraft:tick". Server only: BDS accepts it in packs but sends nothing to clients (BDS 1.26.36.1, 1.26.45.1, 1.26.52.3, 1.26.63.1, 1.26.70.24), so it has no client effect. Palettes leave it out without a warning.

0.1.0
